part.text:
Fixed `routergroup.go:198`: the static handler now uses `engine.noRoute` instead of `engine.allNoRoute`, so middleware is not executed a second time when `StaticFS` returns 404, while custom `NoRoute` handlers still run.

Validation: `go test -skip "^TestUnixSocket$" ./...` passes. (`TestUnixSocket` fails due to the container environment, unrelated to this change.)
